summary: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli seized the early advantage over McLaren's Lando Norris in opening practice at Zandvoort, signaling a tight battle between the sport's two fastest teams heading into the Dutch Grand Prix's final weekend. Red Bull faces a significant disadvantage with Isack Hadjar sidelined by a wrist injury, leaving the championship contenders short-staffed during a crucial stretch of the season. A strong result here would prove decisive for either Mercedes or McLaren in the title fight, while also marking Zandvoort's farewell to Formula 1 after nearly two decades as a permanent fixture on the calendar.
